name: year-split team stat sums the per-week team attribution within each year (executed-result parity)
description: A year split is season grain -- one cell per (player, year) -- so each of its cells must also equal the sum of that year's week cells. The seed spans two seasons so a missing year key in the wrap is visible rather than invisible: in 2023 the player is on ZYA for weeks 1 and 2 and ZYB for week 3, giving 10 + 20 + 77 = 107, and in 2024 he is on ZYB for weeks 1 and 2, giving 5 + 6 = 11. ZYA also plays 2023 week 3 without him, so the year-grain majority rule renders 60 for 2023; pooling the two years together instead of keying on year renders 118 on both rows. The oracle is the seeded pass_yards summed per team-week over the team he was attached to that week, derived from the seed rather than from output.
